name: Goa Beach Escape
description: Sun, sand and sea! Explore the famous beaches of North and South Goa, water sports, Portuguese heritage churches, and Dudhsagar Waterfalls.

name: Kerala God's Own Country
description: Experience the serene backwaters of Alleppey on a houseboat, the lush tea gardens of Munnar, pristine beaches of Kovalam and Ayurvedic wellness.

name: Rajasthan Royal Heritage Tour
description: Discover the royal forts and palaces of Jaipur, the blue city of Jodhpur, the lake city of Udaipur, and the golden sand dunes of Jaisalmer.

name: Kashmir Paradise
description: Experience the heaven on earth — Dal Lake shikara rides, Gulmarg Gondola (Asia's highest), Pahalgam valley, Mughal gardens and luxury houseboat stays.
best_time: March to June, December to January

name: Manali-Spiti Adventure
description: Trek through Rohtang Pass, explore the surreal Spiti Valley monasteries, enjoy snow activities at Solang Valley and river rafting in Kullu.

name: Leh-Ladakh High Altitude Adventure
description: Ride through the world's highest motorable road, camp beside Pangong Lake, explore Nubra Valley on a camel and visit ancient Hemis Monastery.

name: Andaman Island Paradise
description: Dive into crystal clear waters of Asia's best beaches, explore the historic Cellular Jail, snorkel through vibrant coral reefs at Havelock and Neil Islands.

name: Varanasi & Agra Spiritual Tour
description: Witness the divine Ganga Aarti at Varanasi's ancient ghats, visit Sarnath Buddhist site, and marvel at the magnificent Taj Mahal at sunrise in Agra.

name: Meghalaya & Assam Northeast Explorer
description: Walk on living root bridges at Cherrapunji, spot one-horned rhinos at Kaziranga, kayak on the crystal-clear Dawki River and visit Asia's cleanest village.

name: Darjeeling & Sikkim Himalayan Tour
description: Watch sunrise over Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill, ride the iconic Darjeeling Toy Train, visit Rumtek Monastery in Gangtok and the Indo-China border at Nathula Pass.
best_time: March to May, September to December

name: Rajasthan Budget Heritage Trail
description: Explore the royal heritage of Jaipur and Jodhpur on a budget — visit Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Mehrangarh Fort and experience local Rajasthani cuisine.

name: Lakshadweep Coral Island Retreat
description: India's own tropical paradise — pristine lagoons of Agatti Island, world-class snorkeling in coral reefs, luxury resort stay and glass-bottom boat rides.

name: Coorg & Karnataka Explorer
description: Breathe in the fresh aroma of Coorg coffee estates, explore UNESCO ruins of Hampi, witness the illuminated Mysore Palace and visit majestic Jog Falls.

name: Gujarat Heritage & Wildlife Tour
description: Go on an Asiatic Lion safari at Gir, witness the surreal white desert of Rann of Kutch during Rann Utsav, visit the Statue of Unity and ancient Dwarka temple.

name: Odisha Spiritual & Beach Tour
description: Seek blessings at the sacred Jagannath Temple in Puri, marvel at the Sun Temple of Konark (UNESCO), relax on Puri's golden beach and explore Chilika Lake.
